subject: Post-demo: Decision owners, procurement path & advocate reinforcement
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@aurorafinance.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:10 -0500
Subject: Post-demo: Decision owners, procurement path & advocate reinforcement

Hi Julia — great time today, thanks for taking the call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned with your internal review: 

Demo highlights (very brief):
- 15m latency for our typical inference path at your pilot scale
- Prefix caching reduced token cost estimate by ~22% on your sample workload
- Built-in audit logs & KMS integration demonstrated in the security appendix

Decision criteria you called out:
1) Clear cost per 1M tokens at pilot scale (incl. cache/batching assumptions)
2) Data residency / VPC requirements for auditability
3) SOC2 + penetration testing evidence for procurement
4) SLA / uptime and escalation route for Prod traffic

Asks / next steps: 
- Can you confirm the economic buyer and the procurement contact we should engage? (we want to avoid looping the wrong stakeholders)
- If possible, share the security questionnaire or point us to the procurement portal.
- We attached a one-page SOW and a security checklist draft for your procurement/legal review (redwood-pilot-sow.pdf, security-checklist.xlsx).

Ben & Marissa — I’ve CC’d you to own a short advocate pack for Julia to use with the economic buyer. Suggested: 3-slide ROI snippet + 2-minute talking points for Carlos. 

If we can get buyer names and the procurement timeline by EOW, we’ll circulate an MAP (mutual action plan) and a refined SOW. 

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-pilot-sow.pdf (summary SOW), security-checklist.xlsx (draft answers)

From: Julia Park <julia.park@aurorafinance.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procure@aurorafinance.com
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:08 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Decision owners, procurement path & advocate reinforcement

Thanks Neha — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers: 

- Economic buyer: Carlos Mendoza (VP Product) — carlos.mendoza@aurorafinance.com
- Procurement contact: procure@aurorafinance.com (I added them here)
- Timeline: Our procurement window for pilots is typically 3–4 weeks from initial SOW submission; legal review can add another 1–2 weeks.

Security ask: please send SOC2 report (or SOC2 letter) and any pen-test summary you have. Our infosec will also push a short questionnaire; I can route it to your security lead once I have it.

On the ROI side, Carlos will want a simple delta TCO for the pilot vs our current hosted spend (monthly baseline + expected usage), plus one slide showing ops impact (SRE time saved). Happy to run the initial internal sell with Carlos next Tue if you can send a short advocate pack beforehand.

Julia Park
Sr. PM, Platform Integrations | Aurora Finance
julia.park@aurorafinance.com

Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 11:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Decision owners, procurement path & advocate reinforcement

Thanks Julia — adding detail on pricing bands and an initial advocate kit below. Neha / Marissa: feel free to edit and send to Julia.

Pricing (pilot, 3-month scoped pilot):
- Option A (Conservative): $12,500 / month — single-region hosted, up to 50M tokens/month, standard caching
- Option B (Optimized): $18,000 / month — multi-region failover, prefix-cache enabled, 10% discount for annualized commit
- Add-on: Dedicated capacity pool (optional) priced separately; we’ll provide sizing after pilot metric review.

ROI bullets (2-minute talk track for Carlos):
- Expected token cost reduction: 15–25% from caching + batching at your typical seq-lengths
- Developer productivity: estimate ~2 FTE-months saved in ops for runbook & infra work during the pilot (qualitative but important)
- Time-to-value: pilot produces production-grade latency & cost estimates in 6–8 weeks; reduces procurement uncertainty for larger rollout

Attachments: pilot-scope-v1.docx (scope + KPIs).

Suggested MAP items we’ll own:
1) Redwood sends updated SOW + SOC2 via DocuSign (Neha) — target: Feb 18
2) Aurora provides procurement questionnaire & target dates (Julia) — target: Feb 16
3) Intro call with Carlos to review ROI slides (scheduled by Julia) — target: Feb 24
4) Legal redlines consolidated in HubSpot linked doc (Ben / Marissa to own)

HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/RDW-4812
